content:
AI Safety Research Scientist — Beneficial AI Foundation (Remote or Cambridge, MA)

Application form: https://docs.google.com/forms/d/1K1sSJQXK0nNmCSu_j54G0jl-XVPMTJSHtBVzSzaXEjQ/viewform?edit_requested=true

The Beneficial AI Foundation is hiring an AI Safety Research Scientist to work with Max Tegmark and colleagues at the Beneficial AI Foundation (https://www.beneficialaifoundation.org/) on turbocharging formal verification with AI tools as described here and in Towards Guaranteed Safe AI (a high-level introduction is given in the 2nd half of this TED talk). 

The core idea is not to deploy untrusted neural networks directly, but to use AI to help produce verified code implementing learned algorithms and knowledge safely and reliably.

This role may be especially interesting to people in the Lean/formal verification community who want to contribute to open-source projects that strengthen the software verification ecosystem for everyone, while working on technically ambitious problems at the intersection of formal verification, machine learning, and AI safety.

The position can be either remote or by MIT in Cambridge, Massachusetts.

Ideal candidate:

  • Significant experience in formal verification, ideally with a PhD or equivalent depth of experience
  • Strong programming skills
  • Interest in mathematics and machine learning
  • Motivated by AI safety and ensuring powerful AI systems remain under human control
  • Comfortable working independently

Compensation: $70,000–$180,000 USD depending on experience and qualifications.
